comparison.method: Read baseline Git blob objects and actual regular working files; compare SHA-256, Git blob SHA-1, byte lengths and executable modes; enumerate additions and deletions
comparison.exclusionReason: research-data/eth-review-scope.json is review routing metadata owned by this change; no model, ledger, raw observation or archive path is excluded

generatedWorkingArtifacts.scope: Existing generated publication metadata from the earlier replay delivery, retained without deletion. A later local build may regenerate this artifact; its hash describes this observation only.

workingTree.scope: Actual local working bytes at the recorded interval. This is not an attestation of a future commit, remote branch, full release or external review.

additionalLongHorizonGraph.label: Additional BTC product graph preservation; separate from the three ETH model bindings

originalRecords.legacyGraphQualification: All original BTC/asset record-bound source paths match baseline working bytes. Per-file fields explicitly show whether their older recorded source graph equals current bytes; preserved historical source commits are never relabeled.

focusedTests82.proofScope: 42 new IO/inventory tests plus 40 existing remote tests; actual local Node execution, native Git oracle, real temporary filesystem races, offline transport fixtures. No live GitHub publication.
focusedTests82.productionTransportQualification: Production uses three REST metadata reads plus one verified Git-pack fetch; the 4096 REST request limit is for diagnostic REST blob reads and publication requests, not one REST call per retained production blob.

inspected: bounded FD reads and post-read pathname binding
immutable hard-link publication and unchanged-parent checks
mutable prior-byte conflict detection and atomic rename
descriptor-only Git tree and original receipt inventory binding
production pack and REST diagnostic distinction
sameSessionReview.scopeQualification: Targeted same-session code inspection and the separately recorded 82-test run. Other owners finalize archive operations and integration gates; no third-party or external review is represented.
sameSessionReview.concurrencyQualification: A concurrent equal-byte writer may reject a detected ctime read race caused by temporary-link removal; final bytes remain exact and a subsequent identical retry succeeds.
